generated_for: Suhail Medical Dictionary v20.17 UI/Anatomy Repair

status_scale.implemented: Working local feature exists in this checkpoint.
status_scale.partial: Foundation exists, but content/detail coverage is not yet complete.
status_scale.planned: Not implemented as a complete production feature in this checkpoint.

modules.name: Zero-Cost Core
modules.details: Core sign-in, Dictionary, 3D Anatomy, Clinical Reference, Offline Packs, local study-chat storage and the source-bounded Offline Study Engine run without a paid API, paid database or required cloud account.
limitations: Optional third-party free cloud services can change their quotas or terms; they are enhancements, not runtime requirements.
Web hosting/domain choices outside the project can have their own costs; the application itself can be served from a local machine or any suitable free static host.

modules.name: Medical Dictionary
modules.details: 1158 bundled educational terms with related-term links, Clinical Reference links, direct 3D Anatomy links, offline packs and 660 draft Pashto/Dari term-name localizations.
limitations: The bundled dataset is an educational reference collection, not a complete professional medical encyclopedia.
Not every term has a reviewed translation in every UI language.
Content expansion still requires medical/editorial review.

modules.name: 3D Anatomy
modules.details: Interactive local WebGL anatomy with 624 selectable schematic structures, direct HD whole-body male/female skeleton profiles, click/tap region selection, highlighting, labels, pronunciation, saved views, layers and study presets.
limitations: The bundled geometry remains schematic educational illustration rather than a clinically precise anatomy atlas.
Not every individual vessel, nerve, muscle, ligament, organ substructure or microscopic structure is modeled separately.
Not intended for diagnosis, procedural planning or surgery.
Whole-body male/female skeleton geometry is procedural educational geometry, not a clinically precise dissection atlas.

modules.name: Clinical Reference
modules.details: Offline educational Conditions, Procedures and high-level Pharmacology cards with filters, Dictionary navigation and selected 3D Anatomy cross-navigation. Content scale and human medical review remain partial.
limitations: Content volume is much smaller than a large professional clinical-reference platform.
Formula tools return educational numeric results without individualized diagnosis or treatment interpretation.
Medication-pair advice remains intentionally unavailable without an appropriate verified clinical dataset.

modules.name: Study Engine / Optional AI
modules.details: Explain, Compare, Quiz, Flashcards and Summary modes work locally from bundled Dictionary and Clinical Reference data. Local chat history is stored on-device. Optional free cloud AI can be configured separately, with automatic local fallback.
limitations: The local engine is source-bounded and intentionally does not invent facts absent from bundled data.
Optional cloud AI and translation availability depends on the chosen third-party free service; no paid fallback is enabled.
Study output is educational and not a substitute for professional medical care.

modules.name: Admin Panel
modules.details: Owner dashboard works in local Zero-Cost Mode with local user, chat/message counts, content health and local activity events. Optional cloud metrics and consent-aware cross-user support audit are available only when a compatible cloud backend is intentionally configured.
limitations: Local-only mode has no cross-device or cross-user centralized metrics because there is no required cloud database.

modules.name: PWA / Offline
modules.details: Installable manifest, service worker, dictionary packs, expanded 3D anatomy packs, Clinical Reference data and Offline Study Engine assets are available for local use.
limitations: Large HD/Ultra anatomy packs can require significant device storage.
Browser PWA behavior varies by platform and should be verified on target devices before public release.

release_scope_note: Core software workflow is complete for the declared educational/offline scope. Medical content remains non-exhaustive and draft Pashto/Dari terminology still requires qualified review.
